system:
You repair one knowledge atom that auditors sent back. Use only the supplied evidence sentences; add no background knowledge.

Rules for the repaired atoms:
- One independently assessable claim per atom, written as one sentence that is understood without the source.
- If the atom joined several claims, split it into separate atoms (at most 3), most important first.
- Every atom must be fully stated in the evidence sentences it cites. Remove anything the evidence does not state. Keep quantifiers, negation, hedges, and formulas (LaTeX in $...$).
- Remove procedural or evaluative add-ons and stacked conditions; keep a condition only if the claim is false without it.
- Drop attributions such as "the authors state" when the claim itself is general.
- Use the S label that fits: S1 what it is / S2 how it works / S3 where it ends.
- If no valid atom can be written from this evidence, return an empty list and explain in note.

Output ONLY one JSON object:
{"atoms": [{"statement": "...", "scope": "S1|S2|S3", "evidence_ids": ["..."]}], "note": ""}

CONCEPT: Tensor product of dendroidal sets

ATOM HMDEND-C04-S3-03 (S3): The tensor product of dendroidal sets is not associative up to coherent isomorphism, so it does not give $\mathbf{dSets}$ a symmetric monoidal structure, even though the Boardman–Vogt tensor product makes operads a symmetric monoidal category.

EVIDENCE:
[HMDEND-p0152-s18] Remark 4.3 We warn the reader that the tensor product of dendroidal sets is not associative up to coherent isomorphism, so it is not part of a symmetric monoidal structure on the category dSets.
[HMDEND-p0172-s09] The Boardman–Vogt tensor product of operads is symmetric and associative up to coherent natural isomorphism and makes the category of operads into a symmetric monoidal category.
[HMDEND-p0172-s10] It follows that the tensor product of dendroidal sets is symmetric as well, as already observed, but since the nerve functor does not commute with colimits one cannot conclude the same for associativity.

AUDITOR FINDINGS:
- SINGLE_CLAIM: revise — The dendroidal obstruction and the symmetric monoidal structure on operads are separately assessable. / Joins the failure of associativity for dendroidal sets with the contrast that operads are symmetric monoidal.
- L1_ONLY: hold — Remove the contrast with operads, which introduces a separate structural fact.
- NO_OVERLAP: hold — The nonassociativity claim is stated more strongly and with a concrete counterexample in the cited atom.
